about.p1: Sbace Dreamer Creative is a design studio focused on creating premium websites for service businesses that take pride in their craftsmanship.
about.p2:
We believe a great website should do more than look impressive—it should build trust before the first conversation even begins.

Every project is designed with clarity, performance, and conversion in mind, helping contractors present their work professionally and attract higher-quality clients.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How long does a project take?
faq.a1: Most standard website projects take between 4 to 6 weeks from our initial discovery call to final launch. This timeline depends on the complexity of the build and how quickly content and feedback are provided.
faq.q2: Can you redesign an existing website?
faq.a2: Absolutely. A significant portion of our work involves taking outdated, underperforming websites and transforming them into modern, high-converting digital assets that reflect the current quality of your business.
faq.q3: Do I need to provide content?
faq.a3: We highly recommend you provide images of your own work to build authentic trust. For copywriting, we can collaborate. You provide the raw information about your services, and we can help refine it for conversion, or we can partner with professional copywriters if needed.
faq.q4: Will my website work on mobile?
faq.a4: Yes. Over 60% of local service inquiries come from mobile devices. We utilize a mobile-first design approach, ensuring your website looks flawless and functions perfectly on smartphones and tablets.
faq.q5: Do you offer support after launch?
faq.a5: We do. We offer post-launch support and ongoing maintenance retainers to ensure your website remains secure, updated, and continues to perform optimally as your business grows.
faq.q6: Can you help with hosting and domains?
faq.a6: Yes, we can handle the technical setup for you. We recommend and configure premium, high-speed hosting solutions to ensure your site is incredibly fast and completely secure.
faq.a7: Our standard process includes two dedicated rounds of revisions during the UI Design phase. Because our Discovery and Strategy phases are so thorough, this is almost always enough to achieve a perfect final result.
faq.a8: Everything we build at SBA Creative is custom. We do not rely on pre-made templates. Your website will be uniquely designed and coded specifically to match your brand identity and business objectives.

cs1Page.title: Prime Coat Painting Case Study | SBA Creative
cs1Page.metaDesc: How SBA Creative designed a high-converting, premium website for a painting contractor to boost sales and outshine the local competition.

hero.title: Engineering Trust: How Premium Design Doubles Contractor Lead Conversions.
hero.desc: We transformed Prime Coat Painting's digital presence from a standard digital brochure into a high-end lead generation engine. By leveraging strategic trust signals and premium aesthetics, the site positions them as the undisputed professional choice in their local market.

meta.servicesValue: UX/UI Design, Web Development, Conversion Strategy

strategy.title: The Anatomy of a High-Converting Site
strategy.desc: Homeowners are deeply protective of their property. To win high-ticket exterior and cabinet painting jobs, a contractor's website must eliminate anxiety and manufacture trust within the first 3 seconds of a visit.

b1.title: Manufacturing Instant Trust
b1.desc: We didn't just place a hero image; we engineered a "Trust Strip" above the fold. By immediately presenting floating badges—"4.9 Rating," "320+ Homes Painted," and "Licensed & Insured"—we answer the homeowner's most critical subconscious questions instantly. This layout immediately validates their premium pricing and prevents price-shopping.

b2.title: Interactive Proof of Craftsmanship
b2.desc: Painting is a visual industry, yet most contractors rely on static, low-quality galleries. We integrated a dynamic Before/After interactive slider for the "Signature Transformations" section. This interactive element keeps users on the page longer, increasing engagement metrics, and provides undeniable, psychological proof of the contractor's capability.

b3.title: Frictionless User Journeys
b3.desc: A confused mind says no. We implemented a sticky navigation bar with a highly visible, contrasting "Get Free Estimate" CTA. Paired with a massive, four-step numbered "Process" section, we demystified the customer journey. When homeowners know exactly what happens after they click "Contact," conversion rates skyrocket.

statement.quote: “When your website looks expensive, clients expect to pay a premium.”

cta.desc: Stop losing high-value jobs to competitors with better branding. Let's build a website that reflects the true quality of your craftsmanship.

cs3Page.title: Commercial Painting Case Study | SBA Creative
cs3Page.metaDesc: How SBA Creative designed a high-performance B2B website for a commercial painting contractor to convert facility managers and general contractors.

hero.title: Built for Scale & Precision.
hero.desc: Facility managers and general contractors don't buy on emotion; they buy on capability, safety, and scale. We engineered a robust B2B digital platform that immediately proves this commercial painting contractor can handle massive, complex projects without operational downtime.

meta.servicesValue: B2B UX/UI Design, Web Development, Copywriting
meta.goalValue: Generate RFPs from facility managers and GCs

strategy.title: Engineering a B2B Lead Generation Engine
strategy.desc: Selling to businesses requires a fundamentally different architecture than selling to homeowners. The site needs to serve as a comprehensive capabilities deck, proving compliance, efficiency, and industry-specific expertise at a glance.

b1.title: Industry-Specific Authority
b1.desc: Commercial clients need to know you understand their specific environment. We designed a clear "Industries We Serve" taxonomy, allowing users in healthcare, retail, or industrial sectors to instantly self-identify and verify the contractor's relevant experience.

b2.title: The B2B Trust Matrix
b2.desc: Instead of focusing just on aesthetics, we prioritized operational metrics. By heavily featuring sections like "Execution Process," massive numerical milestones (200+ Projects, 2M+ Sq Ft), and notable "Client Partners," we systematically dismantled the buyer's perceived risk.

b3.title: Deep-Dive Project Showcases
b3.desc: A simple photo isn't enough for a $100k+ contract. We structured the "Project Showcase" like mini case studies within the site itself—highlighting the square footage, materials used, and specific challenges overcome, providing the exact data points GCs need to justify their hiring decisions.

statement.quote: “In commercial services, operational certainty is your most valuable product.”
